name: Blocked Gather-GEMM-Scatter Sparse Convolution
definition: An optimization for sparse convolution that minimizes wasted MAC operations and global memory traffic by blocking the gather-GEMM-scatter operation on contiguous subsequences of output indices from a VDB data structure, using shared memory for intermediate accumulation.
summary: Blocked Gather-GEMM-Scatter Sparse Convolution optimizes sparse convolution by blocking operations on contiguous output indices to minimize wasted MACs and global memory traffic via shared memory accumulation.
